title: Repair-Damage Arbiter
core_question: Can fold-pure arbitration keep first-sweep repairs while rejecting first-sweep damages?
closest_prior_collision: Wave4/W5 stacking and weighting; Pilot1 routing
why_materially_different: Targets RT600 repair-vs-damage pair residuals directly; uses killed arms only as frozen sensors, not as promoted streams
screen_gate: fold0 marginal_vs_clone >= +0.0015; dominant net > 0; damage-rate cap satisfied
full_confirmation_gate: 5-fold marginal_vs_clone >= +0.0030; positive 4/5 folds; no matched-control failure

title: Dominant-Cell Residual Ranker
core_question: Can a correction model trained on RT600 residual pair inversions move broad dominant-cell pair flow?
closest_prior_collision: generic pairwise objective; W5 hard-negative curricula
why_materially_different: Optimizes residual correction relative to frozen RT600 on metric-dominant same-t pairs, not a standalone BCE break detector
screen_gate: fold0 marginal_vs_clone >= +0.0015; dominant net >= +300 on canonical sample
full_confirmation_gate: 5-fold marginal_vs_clone >= +0.0030; dominant-cell lift positive in every fold

title: Negative-Side Null Calibrator
core_question: Can causal null-state calibration reduce never-break false positives without damaging pre-break ordering?
closest_prior_collision: scalar difficulty gate; m05 context; weighted CTM
why_materially_different: Calibrates incumbent evidence by causal null state rather than adding a new anomaly statistic or tuning CTM
screen_gate: fold0 never-break dominant net > 0; overall marginal_vs_clone >= +0.0010; deranged strata control loses
full_confirmation_gate: 5-fold marginal_vs_clone >= +0.0030; never-break benefit survives with pre-break damage cap

title: Specialist Disagreement Micro-Router
core_question: Can row-level specialist disagreement rescue the 66.3% of RT600 errors with at least one correct specialist?
closest_prior_collision: Pilot1 static fingerprint selectors; ensemble weighting/subset selection
why_materially_different: Uses row-level margin/dispersion state and residual pair target; no static DGP selector and no global weights
screen_gate: fold0 marginal_vs_clone >= +0.0010; majority-correct RT600-error subset repaired with no dominant net loss
full_confirmation_gate: 5-fold marginal_vs_clone >= +0.0030 or close only if paired with SS-01; positive damage-adjusted pair flow
